# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## What exists

- Name (layer 1): `identify` refuses an account with no own profile as `name-needed`; pages
  send it to `/account?next=` (S-125). Commands `give-own-name.ts`, `change-own-name.ts`;
  browser tests answer through the kit's `answerNameScreen`. No name (T-447):
  `local-unnamed-token`. The made-up member is named on the stand-in (`stand-in-ports.ts`).
- Password (layer 2; T-451, T-452, S-127): the interface's `changePassword` (old one counted
  as `confirmPassword`'s guesses, other sessions ended); `server/sign-in/change-own-password.ts`,
  `password-actions.ts`, `features/sign-in/change-password-form.tsx`.
- Email (layer 3; T-455, T-457, T-458, T-461, S-129): `startEmailChange`,
  `confirmEmailChange`; the waiting change is ours, `sign_in.email_changes` (0031, one row per
  sign-in user, code hashed over account, address and code); Supabase moves the address with
  one `PUT /admin/users/{id}` (`setUserEmail`). Commands `start-own-email-change.ts`,
  `confirm-own-email-change.ts`, `email-actions.ts`, `change-email-form.tsx`; port `ownEmail`.
  A new password drops a waiting change (L2).
